name: Terastal Charizard ex Battle Master Deck

releases.name: Terastal Charizard ex Battle Master Deck

description.text: Battle Master Deck Terastal Charizard ex, released on 17 May 2024 with Chien-Pao ex's: a ready-built 60-card deck of the kind that did well in official tournaments, around the Darkness Tera Charizard ex in a new illustration. Its Ability attaches up to three basic Fire Energy from the deck when it evolves, and its attack grows stronger with every Prize card the opponent has taken. Arceus VSTAR, Radiant Charizard and Bibarel back it up. Each box held the deck, 64 deck sleeves, damage counters and markers, a playmat, a coin, a VSTAR marker, a how-to-play guide and the player's guide Road to Battle Master.
